text:
ana_partnerships: starting a short thread to land an "SI handoff concierge" for the marketplace + HW partner roll — aim: clear claim rules, mapping, and who-notifies-who. fast thoughts?

sam_sales: Love that name. Needs to define: what constitutes an SI-intro vs marketplace lead and how crediting works.

mike_se: Suggestion: introduce a tiny lead header in CRM: origin=(si_intro|marketplace), fastpass=true/false, hw_flag. Claim windows: hot=48h, warm=72h. If expired -> escalate.

rachel_ps: Marketing: will create a 1-pager + short email snippets for SI reps. Also need an "SI concierge" bullet in listing copy. Legal to review logo use.

jordan_ops: Ops will add fields and emit webhook when SI claims. Prototype payload: { lead_id, account, route, claimed_by, claim_window_hours } — simple and stable.

tony_si_poc: From SI side: confirm we get a push and a short orientation doc when claim opens. 48-72h windows OK. We prefer a 72h prep buffer for physical demo kits.

ana_partnerships: decision notes: fastpass tokens valid 72h; default co_sell_credit=20% unless partner profile overrides; LOA required for co-billing > $50k. Next steps: sam = list overrides, mike = finalize CRM header, rachel = draft assets, jordan = webhook prototype. Sync Mon 11am PT. :thumbsup:
